settings.title: Brisa Support
What is The Better Unit?
settings.answer: The Better Unit is a non-combustion, non-vapour device designed to help you break the behavioural cycle of vaping and smoking. It uses dry-infused flavour units with no nicotine and no harmful chemicals.

settings.title: Does it contain nicotine or anything harmful?
settings.answer:
No. The Better Unit has zero nicotine, zero smoke, zero vapor, no heating, and no oils entering the mouth.

All materials are food-grade.

settings.title: How does it work?
settings.answer:
When you take a slow draw, air is pressured through the barrel and passes over the flavour core. As it moves through, it picks up the infused aroma and the effect layer.

This creates a calm, familiar sensation that feels close to what you’re used to, without nicotine, smoke, vapour or oils.

settings.title: How long does a flavour unit last?
settings.answer: Most people get up to 2-3 days from each unit, depending on use.

settings.title: What is the flavour composition?
settings.answer:
Our flavour units are made from:

• Organic cotton cores
• Food-grade natural fibre material
• Dry-infused, food-grade aromatic compounds.

There are no liquids, no oils, and nothing heated or inhaled into the lungs, just a light aroma as air passes through the core.

settings.title: Is The Better Unit a quit aid?
settings.answer: BrisaBetter unit is a behavioural wellness tool, not a medical device. It helps replace the habit without making medical claims.

settings.title: Will this help me quit vaping or smoking?
settings.answer:
Many users say The Better unit is the most effective replacement they’ve found for their habit.

It keeps the ritual without the harm, and makes urges easier to handle.

Results are different for everyone, but consistency is where the real change happens.

settings.title: How do I use it?
settings.answer:
Insert a flavour unit, adjust the airflow at the base, and take slow, steady draws.

Use it whenever you’d normally reach for a vape.

settings.title: Is the device reusable?
settings.answer: Yes. The device is a one-time investment. Only the flavour units are replaced.

settings.title: What is the device made from?
settings.answer:
Food-grade anodised aluminium with natural internal materials.

No plastics in the airflow path.

settings.title: Does it feel like vaping?
settings.answer: You get the satisfying ritual and sensory response without the burn, chemicals, or addictive hit.

settings.title: Can I return a product if I’m not happy?
settings.answer: Unused items in original condition can be returned under our Shipping & Returns policy.

settings.title: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Shipping time depends on your location. Full details are on our Shipping & Returns page.

settings.title: Is this for teens?
settings.answer: No. The Better Unit is intended for adults 18+.

settings.title: Can I use it while pregnant or breastfeeding?
settings.answer: No. There’s no research on tools like this for pregnancy or breastfeeding, so out of caution, we recommend avoiding use.

settings.title: We're here to help
settings.content: If you need support with your order, have questions about the Better unit, or want guidance on your quitting journey, reach out anytime. We’ll get back to you as soon as we can.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
We accept returns on unused products in their original condition and packaging. To start a return, email us with your order number and our team will guide you through the steps.

Please note:
• We can’t accept returns on opened flavour units for hygiene reasons.
• Return shipping costs are the responsibility of the customer unless the item arrives damaged or incorrect.

Damaged or incorrect items
If anything arrives damaged, faulty, or not what you ordered, email us immediately at admin@brisabetter.com with a photo. We’ll replace it or sort it out quickly.

settings.title: Product Safety & Disclaimer
settings.content:
Product Safety:
BrisaBetter is made from food-grade materials and dry-infused aromatic compounds. Nothing is heated, burned, vaporised, or aerosolised. There are no liquids, no oils, no nicotine, no chemicals entering the lungs, and no combustion of any kind.

The Better Unit is a behavioural tool designed to support habit change by replacing the hand-to-mouth routine and sensory cues of vaping or smoking. We recommend using BrisaBetter only as directed. 

Disclaimer:
The Better Unit is not a medical device, treatment, or therapeutic aid, It does not claim to diagnose, cure, or treat any condition, addiction, or illness. The Better Unit is intended for adult use (18+) only. Do not use The Better Unit if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

Results will vary depending on your routine, lifestyle habits, and level of consistency. If you have any health concerns, sensitivities, or pre-existing conditions, consult a healthcare professional before use.

settings.title: Questions?
settings.content: If you ever feel unsure, reach out to us at admin@brisabetter.com, we’re here to help.
